title: Dense gas scaling relations at kiloparsec scales across nearby galaxies with the ALMA ALMOND and IRAM 30 m EMPIRE surveys
question: How HCN/CO (dense gas fraction proxy) and SFR/HCN (dense gas star formation efficiency proxy) depend on local stellar surface density, molecular gas surface density and dynamical equilibrium pressure across 31 nearby galaxies from ALMOND and EMPIRE

data.arrays: ALMOND: Morita Atacama Compact Array (ACA); EMPIRE: IRAM 30 m
data.angular_resolution: HCN linear resolution median 1.47 kpc, 16-84% range 1.09-1.76 kpc
data.sensitivity: a few mK (ALMOND and EMPIRE comparable)

what.value: HCN data for ALMOND and EMPIRE galaxies

evidence.quote: We used the HCN data presented in (cite: Jimenez-Donaire2019) and (cite: Neumann2023a).

what.value: PHANGS-ALMA CO(2-1) maps (ALMOND galaxies); EMPIRE CO(1-0) and PAWS (EMPIRE galaxies)

recipe.goal: homogenise HCN and CO maps and integrate intensities
recipe.method: Convolve supporting data to the HCN resolution, sample on a half-beam hexagonal grid and integrate HCN and CO over a velocity window set by the CO emission
key_parameters: Velocity mask from 4-sigma CO peaks expanded into adjacent 2-sigma channels

recipe.goal: derive SFR, stellar mass surface density and dynamical equilibrium pressure
recipe.method: SFR from FUV+22 micron z0MGS maps; Sigma_star from Spitzer 3.6 micron; P_DE from the weight of the ISM in the galaxy potential
assumptions: Stellar mass-to-light ratio 0.6 Msun/Lsun at 3.6 micron
Typical disc flattening ratio to get stellar scale heights from scale lengths (value not stated)

recipe.goal: convert CO and HCN to molecular and dense gas quantities
recipe.method: CO(2-1) scaled to CO(1-0) with a Sigma_SFR-dependent R21; Sigma_mol from variable alpha_CO; fixed alpha_CO and alpha_HCN for reference conversions

recipe.goal: stack HCN and CO spectra in environment bins
recipe.method: Per-galaxy spectral stacking of HCN and CO in logarithmic bins of Sigma_star, Sigma_mol and P_DE, with 3-sigma upper limits where HCN is undetected
key_parameters: Ten bins per galaxy from fixed minima Sigma_star = 30, Sigma_mol = 5 Msun/pc^2, P_DE = 1e4 K/cm^3 up to each galaxy maximum
Centre-versus-disc stacks exclude the centres and use nine bins
assumptions: CO reference velocity (higher S/N than HCN) sets the stacking velocity for each position

recipe.goal: fit scaling relations of HCN/CO and SFR/HCN against environment
recipe.method: Linear fit in log-log space, log10 Y = b + m (log10 X - x0), to all stacks of all galaxies including limits
Place ALMOND and EMPIRE in a 31-survey literature compilation; compute median SFR/HCN, SFE_dense, depletion time and epsilon_ff for subsamples
key_parameters: Dense gas freefall time 0.8 Myr for n_H2 about 3e3 cm^-3
assumptions: Constant C_IR = 1.48e-10 Msun/yr/Lsun to convert SFR to L_IR

recipe.goal: compare galaxy centres with discs and AGN with non-AGN centres
recipe.method: Centre defined as the central beam-size aperture; medians and percentiles of HCN/CO and SFR/HCN in centre, disc, AGN and non-AGN centres

recipe.goal: check consistency of ALMOND and EMPIRE HCN
recipe.method: Compare spectra, voxel-by-voxel brightness temperatures and integrated intensities of the three overlapping galaxies after homogenising resolution
